I love this filter set!  It's my 2nd time buying because I inadvertently threw away a filter or two in the garbage when I emptied the filter basket after using the coffee - duhhh.  You simply fill the filter with ground coffee from your local coffee shop (or wherever).  I try to buy my k-cups at no more than $.50 each but these filters allow me to make coffee at even less a cost!  You simply take out the black basket that is part of your Keurig (probably has an arrow on it) and replace it with this gray basket containing the filter filled with ground coffee.  Place the cap on the basket, insert in your Keurig (any ol' way because there is no arrow) and brew as usual.  When you're done, simply empty the used grounds into the garbage and rinse the filter.  Having multiple filters allows you to not have to wait while the used filter dries.  I had my former set for ages and experienced no holes, tears, cracks, so I'm expecting the same great experience.  I've attached a picture that shows the reusable set in my Keurig and the used k-cup and Keurig basket taken out.
